title: Industry News
description: Monitor industry topics across hot lists and RSS feeds.

news.title: Latest headlines
news.emptyDescription: Configure your sources and topics, then choose Fetch now to collect the latest news.

config.readOnlyHint: Sources are managed globally by a super admin.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Each industry adds a ready-made group of keywords to monitor.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Region groups focus the feed on a geographic market.

keywords.title: Keywords & topics
keywords.description: Words are alternatives; required words must all match and excluded words drop a story.
keywords.empty: No topics yet. Add a topic or choose an industry above.
keywords.wordPlaceholder: Add a keyword and press Enter

globalExcludes.title: Global exclusions
globalExcludes.description: Matching stories containing any of these words are dropped everywhere.

sources.title: Information sources
sources.description: Choose the hot lists and RSS feeds to collect from. No API key is required.
sources.hint: Toggle a source to include it in the next fetch.

report.title: Report settings
report.description: Control ranking, display and how fresh a story must be.

ai.title: AI analysis
ai.description: Optional: translate titles and summaries into a target language and add a short business reading.
ai.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. focus on supply-chain and price risk
ai.hint: Requires a server-side CRM_AI_API_KEY. Without it, articles are collected normally.

ingest.aiUnconfigured: AI is enabled but no server-side model key is configured.
